verdict.rationale: Outlook's first-party Microsoft Graph mail API lets apps draft, send, read, sync and apply rules on mail over plain HTTP from any platform, which makes UI-free scripted automation possible. However, nothing documents a headless mode, a CLI, CI-specific guidance, or unattended (app-only) authentication for pipelines. Missing for 10: a documented headless/CLI runner, CI integration guidance, unattended service authentication in CI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
